name: Echo Grotto
mechanic: emit sonar pings to briefly paint a pitch-black cave in sound while lurking beasts home in on your echoes
theme: a blind bat feeling its way through five lightless caverns toward daylight
tagline: You were born blind. Sound is your sight.
controls: arrows / WASD or hold to glide, tap or space to ping

name: Muster!
mechanic: herd a flock by pressure - sheep flee the dog, so you push from behind and bark to scatter them, scare wolves or enrage the ram
theme: a sheepdog working five sunlit fields against the clock
tagline: The flock has opinions. You have a whistle.
controls: mouse / touch or WASD / arrows to run, space or B to bark
